business_problem: BambooHR needed employees to get accurate answers to routine HR questions without overloading HR teams, while also handling sensitive employee data, company-specific terminology, and strict privacy requirements such as GDPR.
solution_summary: BambooHR built Ask BambooHR as an AI-powered assistant inside the BambooHR platform to answer employee questions about policies, benefits, records, and company information. The system draws from centralized HR data such as organizational charts, employee records, and company manuals, then uses a retrieval pipeline designed with Cohere. Query and document understanding run through Cohere Embed so the platform can match meaning instead of keywords, which matters for industry-specific jargon such as the difference between '401k' and 'pension.' Cohere Rerank then sorts candidate results against the original question before the assistant returns a context-specific answer. The implementation respects existing data-access permissions, uses in-house automated evaluations plus customer beta feedback, and keeps the workflow aligned with GDPR and broader sensitive-data handling requirements.

solution_components.name: Ask BambooHR
solution_components.role: Serves as the employee-facing assistant for HR questions inside the BambooHR platform.

solution_components.name: Cohere Embed
solution_components.role: Represents employee questions and HR content semantically so retrieval can match meaning instead of simple keywords.

solution_components.name: Cohere Rerank
solution_components.role: Reorders retrieved HR content to keep the final answer accurate and context specific.

data_flow: An employee asks Ask BambooHR a question, Cohere Embed turns the question and HR content into semantic representations, the system compares the query against policies and records, Cohere Rerank sorts the best matches, and the assistant returns an answer that respects the user's data permissions.
business_outcome: Ask BambooHR now delivers precise, real-time answers that improve employee experience, answer tens of thousands of questions, save thousands of hours for HR professionals, and let HR teams focus more of their time on strategic work instead of repetitive inquiries.
